writeup: TIC 447350975 is a candidate eclipsing binary star identified through automated analysis of TESS photometry. The system shows a primary eclipse with a depth of 1.65 percent and an orbital period of 1.4237 days, producing a strong detection signal with a BLS significance of 118.7. Pixel-level imaging analysis provides additional support, with a difference-imaging peak signal-to-noise of 8.9, though the centroid offset of 6.9 arcsec from the target warrants consideration. No secondary eclipse was detected. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, suggesting it may represent a previously unknown system. The machine-learning screening assigned this target a score of 0.83, and the data passed all quality checks without flags.
